description: Icon-focused button variant that wraps uui-general-button with showIcon always true. Supports cap positioning (left/right) and flat visual type. Intended for toolbar actions and compact UI areas.

inputs.name: id
inputs.description: Element ID, also used for data-testing-id attribute binding

inputs.name: buttonText
inputs.description: Optional button display text alongside the icon

inputs.name: disableButton
inputs.description: Alternative disable flag (deprecated — use disabled instead)

inputs.name: disableTooltipContent
inputs.description: Tooltip text shown when button is disabled

inputs.name: icon
inputs.description: Font Awesome icon class for left icon

inputs.name: iconCap
inputs.description: Font Awesome icon class for right icon

inputs.name: uiIconName
inputs.description: SVG icon name for the left icon (signal input)

inputs.name: uiIconCapName
inputs.description: SVG icon name for the right cap icon (signal input)

inputs.name: iconColor
inputs.description: Color for the SVG icon (signal input)

inputs.name: iconSize
inputs.description: Size for the SVG icon (signal input)

inputs.name: capPosition
inputs.description: Position suffix for cap styling. Value is used to build CSS class '{value}-cap-button' (e.g., 'left' produces 'left-cap-button'). Signal input.

inputs.name: visualType
inputs.description: Visual style type applied as a CSS class (e.g., 'flat'). Signal input.

outputs.name: action
outputs.description: Emitted on button click when not disabled

expected_internal_elements.description: Wraps a uui-general-button with showIcon forced to true and capClass applied via ngClass

behaviors.description: Component renders and is visible in the DOM
The inner general button always has showIcon set to true (icon is always visible)

test.selector: uui-icon-button uui-general-button button span.fa, uui-icon-button uui-general-button button uui-icon

behaviors.description: When capPosition is set, the general button gets the computed cap class
When visualType is set, the general button gets that class
When disabled, the inner general button is also disabled
Clicking the button emits the action event when not disabled
The host element has a data-testing-id attribute matching the id input
